definition: A dissociated state is a mental condition in which the usual flow and integration of conscious thought seem to break apart, so that part of experience is separated from the rest. In this state, the person in their ordinary condition may not know what occurred during the dissociated period, while in the dissociated condition they may be only dimly aware of their surroundings and usual personality.
